hero.title: Valeria Peña Romero
hero.subtitle: Software Development Student | UTVT
hero.bio: Frontend and full-stack developer passionate about building functional, attractive visual interfaces with attention to every detail. Experienced in end-to-end web and mobile app development, database management, and cross-functional team collaboration using efficient methodologies.

about.title: Transforming code, design, and logic into functional digital experiences.
about.p1: Hello, I am Valeria Peña Romero, a sixth-semester Software Development student at Universidad Tecnológica del Valle de Toluca (UTVT).
about.p2: I specialize in both frontend and backend development, though I have a deep passion for the frontend: a space where visual creativity comes to life through transitions, shapes, colors, perspectives, and meticulous attention to every detail for the end user.
about.p3: I consider myself an analytical and organized developer. I excel at teamwork, dividing tasks under pressure, and finding efficient solutions by evaluating alternatives. Beyond writing code, I prioritize user experience, business value, and technical solidity.

tech.title: Tech Stack & Development Tooling
tech.extensions_desc: Specialized tools used to streamline client workflow and debug API responses.
tech.json_debug_desc: Clean analysis and visualization of structured JSON responses from REST and GraphQL APIs.
tech.audit_seo_desc: Load performance tests, web accessibility (a11y), best practices, and technical SEO.
tech.social_preview_desc: Open Graph metatags validation for correct previews on WhatsApp and social media.

business.title: Integrations, Marketing & Business Analytics
business.subtitle: Advanced skills driven by functionality, business value, and user experience.
business.payments_p1: Secure integration of the Stripe API for processing web transactions and payments.
business.payments_p2: Dynamic consumption of third-party services, including news APIs, weather services, and messaging systems.
business.marketing_p1: Strategic configuration and management of ad campaigns using Meta Ads and Google Ads.
business.marketing_p2: Advanced implementation of Metatags and Open Graph, ensuring clean, professional previews on WhatsApp and social media.
business.marketing_p3: Email campaign automation with Brevo, alongside smooth integration of dynamic forms backed by Formspree.
business.analytics_p1: Intelligent processing of internal system data (sales, product catalog, profits, and user metrics) into key actionable insights.
business.analytics_p2: Development of native features to export and download automated reports in Word or Excel formats.
business.docs_p1: Creation, design, and drafting of detailed user manuals, privacy policies, and terms & conditions tailored to website requirements.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: Production web platforms focused on user experience, e-commerce, and digital presence.

ana_sofia.title: Ana Sofía Website
ana_sofia.purpose: Digital platform designed to strengthen public presence, presenting trajectory, activities, and proposals to connect with the community in a structured manner.
ana_sofia.contribution: Integral interface development, responsive design, and web layout. Worked in direct coordination with the Marketing department to align brand identity, optimize content distribution, and ensure a clean, professional user experience.

las_fresas.title: Las Fresas Website
las_fresas.purpose: Specialized e-commerce platform for custom product ordering, streamlining the purchase experience and request automation.
las_fresas.contribution: Full-stack development (PHP and MariaDB). Catalog creation, shopping cart, custom design upload, review system, and interactive chat. Includes a private client portal (order tracking) and a complete admin panel for shipping and payment management.

jackie.title: Jackie Website
jackie.purpose: E-commerce platform for pet products, designed to deliver a safe, interactive experience supporting animal welfare.
jackie.contribution: PHP/MySQL backend development and responsive interface. Shopping cart, interactive order tracking timeline, and payment receipt management. Highlights include the PetMatch recommendation module and a real-time admin panel.

intamx.title: INTAMX Website
intamx.purpose: Update and optimization of the INTAMX institutional portal (ALBEH Consulting), focusing on academic programs and training services dissemination.
intamx.contribution: Section layout, content structuring, and visual interface enhancements to guarantee a uniform brand identity and seamless navigation.

experience_albeh.title: My Experience at ALBEH GLOBAL
experience_albeh.subtitle: Taking the leap into the real world & learning by doing
experience_albeh.intro_p1: My time at Albeh Global marked a turning point in my development: it was my first official professional role and my first formal experience in the tech industry.
experience_albeh.intro_p2: Although I already possessed technical foundations and theoretical knowledge, facing this environment forced me to connect all those loose pieces to deliver real results. As projects progressed, I realized my initial knowledge had limits against real-world demands. This drove me out of my comfort zone to self-research and experiment with new tools, servers, deployment methodologies, and resources to successfully bring web platforms to production.
experience_albeh.marketing_desc: I learned from scratch how to configure, manage, and scale ad campaigns in Meta Ads and Google Ads—an entirely new domain for me.
experience_albeh.analytics_desc: I applied theoretical statistics and surveys to real scenarios, processing live data and building solutions to export operational reports.
experience_albeh.workplace_desc: It provided me with a mature perspective on project management, meeting critical deadlines, and maintaining clear professional communication.
experience_albeh.recommendation: If you are looking for a place that challenges you, drives you beyond the classroom, and offers a genuine entry into the tech industry, I highly recommend joining Albeh Global. It is a deeply rewarding experience for any developer striving to evolve.
